_comment: Read by internal/api/studio_calls_test.go (the static gate) and by tests/linux/crawl (the runtime crawl). stubs: Studio calls that only a spec-derived stub answers (reach crawl: the crawl must see it; static: it is not reachable by the crawl). statuses: honest 4xx/5xx answers of handlers, by route and status. dom: page texts the crawl's oracles would flag. An entry needs a reason; an entry that no longer applies fails the run, so the lists only shrink.

statuses.reason: The dashboard's Feedback button would send the message nowhere; the refusal points to the issue tracker.
The Auth overview's usage numbers come from logs, which a node does not keep; Studio shows its error alert and the message names supavise logs.
Studio asks for the feature flags before the session exists, on the sign-in page; the call is repeated once the session is there.
An organization with no SSO provider answers 404 "Failed to find an existing SSO Provider", which Studio turns into "no provider is set up" and shows the page for that case.

A server without a GitHub App answers 404 to everybody, and one with an App answers 404 to a user who has not authorized it. Studio's getGitHubAuthorization turns any error into "not connected", and patch 0007 hides the GitHub surfaces while there is no App.

A run is owned by one ref: the branch for a create, a push and a reset, the parent for a merge. Studio polls a run under both refs and stops on the 404 of the one that does not own it, as it does on hosted.
The log of a run answers under the ref that owns the run only; Studio asks both refs, as on hosted.
GoTrue here signs with the legacy secret only; the buttons that create a key answer a refusal that Studio shows as a toast.
The legacy secret is not migrated to a signing key, as on a hosted project that has not migrated; Studio then offers Change legacy JWT secret.
Migrating the legacy secret to a signing key is not supported; the dialog shows the refusal.
No signing key exists to delete; the page lists none.
A signing key has no id here (HS256 with the legacy secret only); the JWT keys page lists none, so it never asks for one.
No signing key exists to rotate or revoke; the page lists none.
The services of a node accept the project's own JWTs only; the add dialog shows the reason in its error toast.
The list is empty, so no integration has an id to delete.
The list is empty, so no integration has an id to read.
Database settings reads it and shows the switch disabled with "Your project does not have access to SSL enforcement"; Studio matches the message text.
The switch is disabled, so Studio never sends the update; the refusal is for API clients.
A project with no custom hostname answers 400 "Project does not have a custom hostname configuration", as hosted does; Studio matches the message and shows the form to add a domain.
The Download backups menu of a paused project asks for a Storage archive that a node does not make; the refusal ends Studio's polling and gives the reason.
The Download backups menu of a paused project asks for a Storage archive that a node does not make; the refusal gives the reason.
A node has no download of a paused project's backup; the refusal gives the reason, and the menu item stays disabled because pause/status names no downloadable backup.
A dashboard account is identified by its email address, so Account > Preferences refuses to change it and names the commands that invite a new address and remove the old account.

SQL on a project that is not active yet answers 503 "Project is not ready". Studio opens the home of a branch the moment its Create branch dialog succeeds, while the branch is still coming up; only the create-branch-dialog probe reaches this, and whether Studio asks before the branch is healthy is a matter of timing, so the crawl cannot require it.
SQL on a project that its owner paused answers 409 "Project is paused; restore it first"; Studio shows its paused screen in place of the pages that query.
